rationale: Contingencies ranked by operational severity. out_l12 is most severe: removing l12 causes l13 to overload at 125.7% of its 70 MW rating. out_l34 is second: while it causes no overloads, it islands bus b4 from the rest of the network. out_l23 and out_l13 cause no critical violations and are ranked lower.
